description: This file defines a Tooltip class for Bootstrap v2.0.4, implementing tooltip functionality with methods for showing, hiding, positioning, and configuring tooltips, along with plugin registration.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: A class implementing tooltip behavior for Bootstrap elements, including methods for initialization, content setting, positioning, showing, hiding, and enabling/disabling tooltips.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the tooltip with type, element, and options.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Merges default options with user options and data attributes.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles mouseenter or focus events to show the tooltip with delay.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Handles mouseleave or blur events to hide the tooltip with delay.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the tooltip, positioning it based on options.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides and removes the tooltip with optional transition.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the tooltip content based on title and HTML detection.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the tooltip title from data attributes or options.
